title: Moses and the ROCK
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story 
we hear that Moses made a mistake

HE DID NOT FOLLOW GOD‘S INSTRUCTIONS
The Lord had told Moses to 
SPEAK to the rock
BUT
Moses HIT the rock
SO MOSES WAS NOT ALLOWED TO ENTER THE PROMISED LAND.

The GOOD NEWS is that Moses did go the HEAVEN - which is the real PROMISED LAND
WE MUST TRUST & DO WHAT GOD TELLS US TO DO

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for giving us instructions.
Thank you for showing me what to do.
Thank you that I will live with you in the promised land one day.
Please help me to always follow You.
And to always trust and obey You.
Amen
